newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jiangsu Expressway says IPO 2.5 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Jiangsu Expressway says IPO 2.5 times subscribed.

text.p: Chinese toll road operator Jiangsu Expressway Co Ltd said on Tuesday the public offering of its H-shares was 2.5 times subscribed.
The company issued 1.222 billion new H-shares, or 25 percent of its enlarged share capital, at HK$3.11 each in a global flotation.
Of the issued shares, 61 percent were allocated to an international placing, 32 percent to a strategic placing and the remaining seven percent to the public offer.
Jiangsu Expressway said in a statement that international placing of 747 million shares was 12 times subscribed.
The strategic placing was made to New World Infrastructure Ltd, COSCO Group and Shanghai Industrial Holdings Ltd.
The three companies subscribed for an aggregate of HK$1.2 billion in H-shares which, under the terms of placing, were expected to be held for at least one year, it said.
Jiangsu Expressway, controlled by Communications Department in China's Jiangsu Province, owns and operates the Jiangsu section of Shanghai-Nanjing (Huning) Expressway connecting Shanghai and Nanjing.
